_what: The single source of truth for the Pebble 2.0 film's sample world (TREATMENT §3.3): a small pottery studio getting ready for its open day. Everything here is fictional. make_sample_world.py, the 2.0 harness fixtures (capture/fixtures-2.0) and the real-take runbook (.work/real-takes/RUNBOOK.md) all read these facts, so a date or a name changes in one place.
_embargo: Local branch film-2.0 only. Never push before the release session posts '2.0.0 published'.

studio.name: Clay & Current

name_prescreen.method: standard web searches for each exact name (with 'pottery' or 'pottery studio'); the lead still checks before capture (TREATMENT §3.3)

found.Clay & Current: no business by this name found (closest: 'Clay Co', Phillip Island; 'Clay', Noosa)
found.Slow Wheel Studio: no business by this exact name found; 'Slow Clay Centre' (Melbourne) and 'Slow Pottery Studio' (Andhra Pradesh) are similar
found.Kiln Lane Studio: no studio by this name found; 'Kiln Lane' is a street name in several UK towns, and many studios are called 'The Kiln'

studio.website_note: example.com is reserved for documentation (RFC 2606), so no real site is ever shown or implied.

demo_user.why: A neutral account name: it appears in paths (/Users/studio/...), the login window and the Apple menu, never a person's name.

open_day.date_rule: A Saturday. Regenerate with make_sample_world.py --open-day YYYY-MM-DD before the takes, so that Calendar's week view shows the open-day week on the day of recording.

tickets.note: 4 wheel tasters x 12 places, all sold. 48 x 12.5 = 600 (the 'Tickets' conversation, S11).

conversations.title: Open day
messages: Play our glazing video on YouTube.
conversations.note: 'our' only if the video is the person's own; with someone else's CC BY video the first message names the video by its exact title instead (RUNBOOK, open item 1).

conversations.title: Kiln Board
messages: In Kiln Board, start the bisque program.

conversations.title: Old price list
messages: Delete the note “Old price list (2025)” in Notes.

conversations.title: Open day jobs
messages: Run my Open day checklist shortcut.
Play the Studio playlist in Music.
Make a note: kiln unload at 9:00, glaze table ready by 9:30.
Add “Glaze order” to my calendar on Monday at 9:00.
Show the Open day folder in Finder.

conversations.title: Photos
messages: Resize the open-day photos in Pictures to 1600 px for the website.
Put Saturday's hours in the flyer: 10:00 to 16:00.
conversations.note: TREATMENT's shorter forms ('Resize the open-day photos to 1600 px for the website.', 'Put Saturday's hours in the flyer.') are tried in the dry run; plan.md beside the flyer holds the hours if Pebble looks for them.

conversations.title: studio-bookings
messages: Saturday's wheel tasters are taking one booking too many. Stop a full slot from taking another booking.

conversations.title: Glaze
messages: Scale the celadon glaze in Documents/Open day/glazes/celadon.csv to a 5 kg batch, and keep the tool for next time.
conversations.note: Reading the file first means the tool was made after file output could shape it, so 1.7.0's rule makes Pebble ask before keeping it: the real route to the ask card.

conversations.title: Kiln
messages: How long will Friday's bisque firing take? The kiln starts at 20 °C. Ramp 1: 80 °C an hour up to 600 °C. Ramp 2: 150 °C an hour up to 1000 °C, then hold for 15 minutes. I fire every week with different ramps, so make a small tool for it and call it kiln_ramp_time.
conversations.note: Everything the tool needs is in the message: no file, page or command output may come before the tool is made, or 1.7.0's rule turns the keep into an ask.

conversations.title: Price list
messages: Open the price list in Preview.
